turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is your PayLite training coach. We'll do a quick five-question check on the Soundbox. Ready?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, a bit nervous, but ready.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: First question. What does the Soundbox cost the merchant?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ninety-nine rupees per month. I think the first month is free.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question two. Which payment types does it support?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: UPI. I'm not sure about cards. I'd check with my manager before telling a merchant.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question three. What documents does a merchant need to sign up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: PAN, I know that. The rest I'm not sure. I'd check the onboarding sheet.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question four. A merchant says, 'I already have a free QR sticker, why should I pay for a Soundbox?' How do you respond?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Umm. I'd say the Soundbox is more convenient. I'm not sure what else to say.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Last one. When does the merchant get the money in their bank account?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I don't know, sorry. Maybe a day or two?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks Kavya, that's the end of the check.
